24 April 2024

Weeknotes No.60

So, it came to an end, my time at the Financial Conduct Authority ended, the computer was handed over, work was placed in their safe and capable hands and farewells done.

I took two weeks off completely from anything work-related (classing LinkedIn, in fact, any social media as work) and it was a joy, it was tiring (two kids mean a lot of walking.. a lot of snack making and a lot of last-minute ideas for entertainment) including a trip to Berwick upon Tweed (which is a lovely place to drop in thanks to Emma’s uncle for letting us stay!).

The contracting gods smiled down upon me as well, turns out you can schedule a start date (hat tip to the security checks as well..), and it turns out clients are out there (I know the market is murky but keep at it).

I do miss my people at Axiologik, and we shall work together again, I can sense it, but I now find myself at AstraZeneca till the end of July, working on a very fun and challenging (for all the right reasons) project and so far I bloody love it!

A short and sweet update this week, as there is a lot of personal things happening at the same time.

Youtube of the week
A different vibe this week, but damnnnnn this is a banger.
